chunks: Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Razzaz narrated to me from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Hanan who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: Go to the Ziyarah of Husayn (peace be upon him) and do not be disinclined to it. Verily he is the Master of the Youth of Paradise from among the creation and he is the Master of the Martyrs.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of visiting Imam Husayn (a.s.) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kamil al-Ziyarat*, Ibn Qulawayh records Imam al-Sadiq’s (a.s.) directive to maintain consistent and affectionate visitation to Imam Husayn (a.s.), warning against spiritual neglect ('tajfu'). This hadith underscores the theological significance of the Karbala event, positioning Imam Husayn not merely as a historical figure but as the eternal 'Master of the Youth of Paradise' and the preeminent model of martyrdom in Shia cosmology.

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 1. Muḥammad ibn Ja’far Al-Razzāz narrated to me from Muḥammad ibn Ḥusain, from Muḥammad ibn Ismā’īl, from Ḥanān who said:

Abū ‘Abdillāh (Imam Sādiq (a.s.)) said: Go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) and do not be disinclined to it. Verily he is the Master of the Youth of Paradise from among the creation and he is the Master of the Martyrs.
